q1.explanationZh: 第二段说这颗星的亮度在十天里突然增加了一百多倍，这引起了科学家的注意。所以是亮度突然变亮。

evidence.quote: Its brightness suddenly increased by more than 100 times over a ten-day period, which caught their attention.

q2.explanationZh: 第三段说恒星吞掉这颗行星用了大约100天。About one day 是行星绕恒星一圈的时间，别混淆。

evidence.quote: The star swallowed a planet over a period of about 100 days.

q3.explanationZh: 第四段说最后十天里，行星剩下的部分完全掉进了恒星，被彻底摧毁。

evidence.quote: When the planet was totally destroyed, there was a bright explosion that made the star shine brightly.

q4.explanationZh: 最后一段说地球将来也会遇到类似的结局：太阳变老时，地球会被毁灭，不过还要五十亿年。

evidence.quote: Earth will meet a similar end when our Sun grows old

q5.explanationZh: 全文讲科学家第一次看到恒星吞噬行星，是在报道一项新的科学发现。

evidence.quote: For the first time, scientists have observed a star swallowing a planet.
